Object LIMU REPS LZAS_FG171UXX is already locked in request A4HK900306 of user ABAPSMITH

Message No. CTS_WBO_API019

Diagnosis

The object LIMU REPS LZAS_FG171UXX cannot be edited under a new request, since it is already locked in the request A4HK900306 for user ABAPSMITH.

System Response

The editing of the object LIMU REPS LZAS_FG171UXX is canceled.

Procedure

You have several options:

  • Edit the object in the request A4HK900306. If necessary, contact the owner ABAPSMITH and use your own task under request A4HK900306.

Release the request A4HK900306 with all its tasks. If necessary, contact the owner ABAPSMITH. You can then edit the object under a new request.
